_comment: Your server inventory. Copy to fleet.servers.json and fill in.
The hub reads this to answer 'which box could absorb this queue?'.
Credentials are OPTIONAL and only used by tooling you run yourself --
the fleet never needs SSH to dispatch work, because workers dial out.
Keep the real file out of git: it is already in .gitignore.

servers.name: audio-01
servers.notes: 4 vCPU / 8 GB - piper voices installed at /opt/voices

servers.name: video-01
servers.notes: 8 vCPU - ffmpeg render box, 1 slot so renders get the whole CPU

servers.name: webinar-01
servers.notes: Hosts the webinar builder app and runs composite jobs

servers.name: workshop-desktop
servers.notes: Machine on the home LAN - reaches the hub outbound, no port forwarding
